episodes_data.title: I Tried Confessing
episodes_data.description: A subordinate of the Demon King falls in love with a priestess in the hero`s party.

episodes_data.description: Celia asks Yoki to take Cecilia out on a date as a break from her daily stresses and obligations.

episodes_data.description: While Yoki is helping Raven win over his crush, they run into another old friend in need of love advice.

episodes_data.description: After Raven and Mikana, Yuga is next to seek advice from Yoki.

episodes_data.description: Teal takes a turn for the worse, and at the same time, Gar is in peril. Can Yoki save both of them in time?

episodes_data.description: Valentine`s Day is for giving chocolate to someone special, but not everyone agrees.

episodes_data.description: Yoki accepts a quest to stop a string of thefts on merchant ships in a port town.

episodes_data.description: Yoki realizes he doesn`t know much about Cecilia, so he tries going on a quest with her to learn more.

episodes_data.description: Raven starts to feel like his own weakness and powerlessness are hurting his chances with Happiness.

episodes_data.title: I Tried Being in a... with My Crush
episodes_data.description: A mysterious figure who looks just like Yoki`s alter-ego is causing chaos in the capital.
